name: Forgery Wing
description: Trained on the full WikiArt corpus, unconditional. Produces degraded art-historical soup — abstract smears, half-formed canvases and melted compositions. Chaotic and poor at high ψ.
provenance: WikiArt (unconditional), trained by Peter Baylies on pbaylies/stylegan2 (StyleGAN2 fork), legacy TF checkpoint converted with legacy.py. WikiArt images for non-commercial research only. https://archive.org/details/wikiart-stylegan2-conditional-model
